note: The IsCitable check of the surface harness (WS-5's IREV3S-01 rule, WS-7 CR). ExplanationTemplater cites a contribution only when IsCitable admits it: positive, and one of the card's two largest positive pushes or at least the floor. The harness re-checks every rendered whyThis against the card's stored contributions (TitleScores.ContributionsJson for the serving artifact): a clause below whose features none is citable is an uncitable clause. 'clauses' is hand-written (the phrasing of each Translate branch); 'rule', 'samples' and 'vectors' are GENERATED by CitableClauseCatalogueTests from ExplanationTemplater itself (REEL_REGENERATE_EVAL_SQL=1), which fails when a Translate phrasing or the rule's constants move without this file.
